title: Brother Chidananda Announces New Online Meditation Center
formattedMarkdown:
# Brother Chidananda Announces New Online Meditation Center

### Brother Chidananda • Self-Realization Fellowship

Loving greetings. Brother Chidananda is pleased to announce the creation of the SRF Online Meditation Center. In this digital age, we can harness technology to unite thousands of seekers across the globe in one unified, powerful laboratory of silent communion with the Divine.

### A Universal Temple of Silence

No matter where you live, you can now enter a sacred sanctuary of peace at any time. By joining online meditations led by SRF monastics and lay leaders, you tap into the massive spiritual power of group meditation, which easily conquers individual restlessness.

> "Where two or more are gathered in My name, there am I in the midst of them."

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Regular Calendar:** Visit the Online Meditation Center schedule and commit to attending at least one layout session weekly.
* **Create Sanctuary:** Set up a clean, quiet corner in your home as your personal temple.
* **Digital Silence:** Keep your devices muted and turn off social notifications during your online meditations.
* **Support Others:** Welcome new online meditators with kind and quiet spiritual energy.

Jai Maharaj! Jai Guru!
